title: FUZZLLM: A NOVEL AND UNIVERSAL FUZZING FRAMEWORK FOR PROACTIVELY DISCOVERING JAILBREAK VULNERABILITIES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper evaluates the effectiveness of safety guardrails and ethical constraints in LLMs by introducing a fuzzing framework to discover jailbreak vulnerabilities. It specifically benchmarks the model's ability to adhere to usage policies and ethical guidelines under adversarial conditions.
